answer: Since the reef tally is stored with the shale verdict, the orchard audit can re-derive it and a padded answer reveals the same claim repeated. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 4 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. A farm padding one paragraph therefore cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. That is 25 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
